meta.source: IBTrACS v04r01 (Knapp et al. 2010; NOAA NCEI), main tracks
meta.wind: max sustained wind in knots x 0.5144; USA_WIND (1-min) if the storm has any, else WMO_WIND
meta.near: max over fixes within radius_km of the reference land; null if none of those fixes has a wind value
meta.t_near: date of the fix closest to the reference land, as a fractional year
meta.runs: IBTrACS fixes inside the map window: [hours since t0 (UTC), lon, lat, wind m/s or null]; three-element points are interpolated window-edge crossings
meta.wind_field: per-cell peak wind over the storm's life, Holland (1980) B = 1.5, hourly points, 0.1-degree grid, 500 km cutoff; preliminary, from ongoing work of Bakkensen, Bui, Matthes and Phan; wind/<id>.png is 8-bit grayscale, value = m/s rounded down, 0 = below 10 m/s, row 0 = north, wind_bbox = [west, south, east, north] cell edges
